old: The cyclohexanone enolate adds 1,4 to MVK, giving 2-(3-oxobutyl)cyclohexanone. The enolate of the side-chain CH3 then attacks the ring C=O, closing a new six-membered ring (intramolecular aldol). With heat the β-hydroxy ketone dehydrates (E1cB) so that the new C=C is conjugated with the C=O: the bicyclic enone A (C10H14O, octahydronaphthalen-2-one).
new: The cyclohexanone enolate adds 1,4 to MVK, giving 2-(3-oxobutyl)cyclohexanone. The enolate of the side-chain CH3 then attacks the ring C=O, closing a new six-membered ring (intramolecular aldol). With heat the β-hydroxy ketone dehydrates (E1cB) so that the new C=C is conjugated with the C=O: the bicyclic enone A (C10H14O, 4,4a,5,6,7,8-hexahydronaphthalen-2(3H)-one).
why: 'octahydronaphthalen-2-one' implies C10H16O (no C=C); the drawn conjugated enone C10H14O is 4,4a,5,6,7,8-hexahydronaphthalen-2(3H)-one
